name: model-router
description: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev. On every Agent call it sends the subagent's task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and its descriptions, with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider option allows, each with its own key. The default agents general-purpose and claude send a fixed text in place of their description.
